items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Well I know Tab because he used to buck every night.

ctx.x: Sherry Wine, Lange Liquor, Claret Wine, and all that kind of stuff. And then Fate and Marvel and them used to come, Tab Smith. You know Tab Smith? I remember. A saxophone player? I remember. Out of St. Louis? Well he'd come down. Well I know Tab because he used to buck every night.
